name: affiliate-error-recovery
description: §18.15 Error Recovery (§20): detects failures (errorTrigger + daily sweep), classifies retryable vs permanent, SPEND GUARD (never auto-spends), bounded retries (3×, 5-min) via REAL POST /api/v1/jobs/:id/retry, manual resume path. Also serves as errorWorkflow for the other affiliate workflows.

nodes.name: error-trigger
nodes.notes: Receives failed executions from workflows linked via errorWorkflow. Internal — no auth needed.

nodes.name: webhook-entry
nodes.notes: Entry: POST {failures?} with x-n8n-secret — the daily sweep trigger.

nodes.name: auth-sweep
nodes.notes: Secret check for the sweep webhook (§21).

nodes.name: normalize-input
nodes.notes: Normalizes both entry shapes into failure items.

nodes.name: classify
nodes.notes: Classifies failures (§20). SPEND GUARD: anything payment/billing-related is NEVER auto-retried — no automatic spending, ever.

nodes.name: park-spend
nodes.notes: §20/§22: payment-related failures are never retried automatically.

nodes.name: if-retryable
nodes.notes: Retryable → bounded retry. Permanent → manual path.

nodes.name: if-budget-left
nodes.notes: Budget left → wait & retry. Else park for manual resume.

nodes.name: has-job-id
nodes.notes: Backend jobId present → use REAL retry endpoint. Else manual resume.

nodes.name: retry-job
nodes.notes: REAL backend endpoint: retries the failed job.

nodes.name: manual-resume
nodes.notes: Manual resume path (§20): clear instructions, no data loss.

nodes.name: park-permanent
nodes.notes: Permanent failures → NEEDS_REVIEW for human decision.
